title: Why is this error comming on Gemini CLI?

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue reports an API error from the backend model ('Unable to submit request because it has 20 video files but the model only supports up to 10') and asks why this error occurred. The Gemini API enforces a limit of 10 video files per request. The issue lacks reproduction steps, the exact CLI command or prompt executed, and details on how the 20 video files were loaded/attached during the session to determine whether this is an expected API limit or an issue in the CLI.
triage_metadata.comment: Hi! Thanks for commenting on this issue, we need more information to triage the bug. Could you please provide the exact CLI command or prompt you ran, step-by-step instructions to reproduce the error, and details on how the 20 video files were attached or included in your request? Note that the underlying Gemini model API currently enforces a limit of 10 video files per request.
